thread:
Anika: quick oncall FYI — I'm swapping into the morning shift tomorrow 09:00 UTC and @Jordan will take the evening. 2 small requests: 1) I want to temporarily suppress noisy batch worker pagers while we run the throughput tests, 2) double-check routing so non-urgent alerts go to #eng-infra and don't page. Details below.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Oncall swap scheduled 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC (Anika -> Jordan).

Sahil: can you list which alert policies you mean? want to avoid muting anything customer-impacting.

Anika: good call. specifically: the batch-gpu/HighLatency pagers that fire on transient 90th/95th latency spikes during bulk ingest. not the frontend/customer-facing latencies. rule tweak I plan: reduce pager severity and route to infra for 6 hours while tests run.

Anika: proposed change (will apply at 09:05 UTC, revert automatically after 6h):
```yaml
alert: BatchGPUHighLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job)) > 2.0
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning   # was critical
  team: eng-infra
annotations:
  summary: "Batch GPU high latency (95th) — routed to infra, suppressed pager"
```

Leo: can we also suppress the 429-rate pagers from the bulk-ingest path for that window? they often spike with load tests and are noisy.

Anika: yeah good call — add a tag to the 429 alert to route to #eng-infra and lower to warning. we will NOT change any alert that has "customer-facing" or "SLO" labels.

Maria: please drop a one-line note in the runbook and in the #eng-oncall pinned messages so the oncall after next knows why temporary silence.

Anika: will update runbook now and pin a message. commands I'll run:
```
# update routing rule
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/alerts/patch -d '{"id":"BatchGPUHighLatency","labels":{"severity":"warning","team":"eng-infra"},"expires_at":"+6h"}'

# add pin
curl -X POST https://slack.api/pins.add -d '{"channel":"CENGONCALL","timestamp":"1832104567"}'
```

Jordan: noted. I'll monitor the infra channel during my evening shift in case something noisy slips through. ping me if the suppression misses anything.

oncall-bot: Route change applied to BatchGPUHighLatency (severity->warning, team->eng-infra), expires in 6h.

Sahil: OK thanks — as long as SLO/edge latencies are untouched, fine by me. :thumbsup:

Anika: thanks team — I'll leave an audit entry and the runbook note. if anything unexpectedly pages, escalate to the standard pager flow. :white_check_mark:"
